name: Mockingbird Infant Car Seat Adapter — Clek Liing
seatBrandsSupported: Clek Liing — this is the Clek-specific version selected from Mockingbird's adapter dropdown. Mockingbird's car-seat adapter line supports 40+ infant seats across Baby Jogger, Britax, Chicco, Clek, Cybex, Graco, Maxi-Cosi, Nuna and UPPAbaby; the Clek variant is literally the 'Clek Liing Car Seat Adapter'.

status.clekNote: Named directly on Clek's official Liing/Liingo list as the Mockingbird 'Clek Liing Car Seat Adapter'. Currently sold out at Mockingbird DTC (email-when-available).

install.notes: Remove the stroller seat from the frame, insert each side of the adapter into the attachment points until you hear a click, then click the car seat into the adapter just like a car-seat base.
